Description: The pygidium terminates in a long cirriform process. Prostomium approximately rectangular, in holotype 0.5mm long, .0.3mm wide, anteriorly truncate, one pair of short, conical antennae on the frontal margin of prostomium; one pair of ventrolateral palps about the same size and shape as the antennae. Two eyespots present near the posterior margin of prostomium, a pair of nuchal organs at the corners ofthe posterior margin of prostomium. Pharynx distally with 20 bifid papillae, dorsal and ventral median papillae absent. Subdistal region with a short middorsal papilla about two times as long as the neighbouring papillae, shorter subdistal papillae decreasing in length towards base of pharynx, arranged in 14 rows proximally, 6-8 papillae per row; no warts (verrucae) present. In some ofthe distal rows the papillae are doubled resulting in 20 papillae when counted around the pharynx. All parapodia biramous, projecting up to 1.2mm, including setae.

Description: The pygidium terminates in a long cirriform process. Description: Prostomium somewhat longer than wide, anterior margin smoothly rounded. Two pairs of prostomial ridges. Palps (paratype) extend to setiger 18, with 4 rows of papillae in the proximal region and 2 rows distally. Thorax: Setigers 1-7 similar; dorsal medial lobes digitiform, notopodial pre- and postsetal lamellae parallel with cross section of the body but the corresponding neuropodiallamellae in supra- and infrasetal positions, postsetal notopodiallamellae broadly flattened, anteriorly with 5 digitiform processes; 3 processes on setiger 7. Setiger 8 with dorsal medial lobe digitiform, presetal noto- and neuropodiallamellae long; postsetal notopodiallamella long with broad base, pointed tip; nipple-shaped postsetal neuropodiallamella. Description: Prostomium pyriform, longer than wide, anterior margin rounded, no frontal horns; two pairs of prostomial ridges. Palps extending to setiger 16, with undefmed rows of papillae in the proximal region and 4 rows distally. Thorax: Notopodia of setigers 1-7 similar; slender dorsal medial lobes, foliaceous postsetal lateral lamellae with pointed tips. Neuropodia of setigers 1-7 with lanceolate ventral neuropodiallobes, smaller than notopodial lateral lamellae, suprasetal part ofneuropodiallobe present on setiger 1. Setiger 8 with notopodia with slender dorsal medial lobe, lateral lamella bilobed, tip rounded; neuropodia with presetal neuropodiallobe and small triangular postsetal neuropodiallobe. Setae of setigers 1-8 bilimbate. Setiger 9 with notopodia with large triangular postsetal lateral lamella and pointed presetallaterallamella; neuropodia with small presetal neuropodiallobe and large triangular postsetal neuropodiallobe. Setae of setiger 9 modified, mucronate.
